concerns.text: FR-001 requires 'calculate structural descriptors (atomic radius, packing fraction) using standard formulas', and plan.md Phase 1 step 3 explicitly tasks 'Parse CIF structures using pymatgen to compute atomic_radius and packing_fraction'. No task in tasks.md computes these descriptors or parses CIFs — T001 only splits, applies PCA, and excludes rows with 'missing required descriptors' that nothing ever creates. The FR-001/plan element has no covering task.

Spec FR-001 and plan Summary scope the study to three target properties (formation energy, bulk modulus, band gap), and the constitution budgets 'UQ evaluation ≤ 20 minutes per property'. Every training/inference task (T002, T003) targets only formation_energy; no task trains or evaluates models for bulk modulus or band gap. Two of three modeled properties have no covering task, and the narrowing is undocumented.

SC-004 requires ECE consistency 'across different random seeds (for ensembles) or inducing point initializations (for GP)' over seeds 42/43/44. T002 trains the ensemble once with fixed member seeds 42–46 and T003 runs Sparse GP inference 'seed-independent, run once and reused', so per-seed ECE (and thus ece_cv in calibration_summary.csv) is degenerate for ensemble and sparse_gp. The SC-004 evidence for two of three methods has no covering task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs constitution.md:Principle VI, plan.md:Performance Goals
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI and plan.md Performance Goals mandate training ≤ 30 minutes and UQ evaluation ≤ 20 minutes per property. No task measures or enforces these sub-budgets; T007 only implements the 5-hour total timeout. A run violating the sub-budgets would pass all task verifications — the plan element is uncovered.

Method-naming mismatch between the two SSoT schemas the tasks must satisfy: calibration_metric.schema.yaml requires enum 'deep_ensemble' while prediction_output.schema.yaml and T005's best_uq_method.txt use 'ensemble'. T005 must emit calibration_summary.csv conforming to the former while T003's CSVs use the latter; tasks should state the canonical mapping so the implementer does not hit a guaranteed schema failure.

Spec's GP-convergence edge case requires fallback to 'a standard GP with full inducing points', but T002 (and plan.md) fall back to 200 inducing points. The task contradicts the spec's stated fallback with no recorded justification; either the task or the spec must be reconciled.

FR-005 requires reporting 'reconstruction variance' and T003 writes gp_reconstruction_variance.json, but no task defines what reconstruction variance is or how it is computed (PCA reconstruction error? GP posterior variance at inducing points?). The requirement is tasked nominally but unverifiable as specified.

T003 writes both per-seed files results/uq_predictions_seed_<seed>.csv and per-method files results/predictions/uq_predictions_*.csv without stating which seed the per-method files correspond to (prediction_output.schema.yaml has no seed column). Ambiguous relative to the contract.
